profile.headline: Cloud Professional - Terraform Expert - Child of God
profile.summary:
GitHub Site: https://github.com/microsoftexpert  1,810 Terraform Modules
Published on HashiCorp Registry: https://registry.terraform.io/search/modules?namespace=microsoftexpert
Email Address:  microsoftexpert@gmail.com

Cloud infrastructure/DevOps engineer with 15+ years designing, automating, and operating enterprise Azure and multi-cloud environments, including 7+ years focused on Microsoft Azure for regulated financial-services organizations (GLBA / FCA). Specialist in Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), multi-tenant governance, identity and access, security, CI/CD, and cloud cost optimization. Author of a public library of 1,810 production Terraform modules across 23 providers — including Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud — comprising 3,099 resources, 22,368 validation rules, and roughly 701,000 lines of documented, versioned Terraform code. Holds CISSP and ISSAP plus five Microsoft Azure certifications (Solutions Architect Expert, DevOps Engineer Expert, Security Engineer, Administrator, and Developer). Consistently recognized for converting manual, click-driven infrastructure into version-controlled, policy-enforced, auditable platforms and for explaining complex cloud architecture clearly to technical and business audiences.

Certifications:
CISSP-ISSAP Certified Information Systems Security Professional-Information Systems Security Architecture Professional
Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator
Microsoft Certified Azure Developer Associate
Microsoft Certified Azure DevOps Engineer Expert
Microsoft Certified Azure Security Engineer
Microsoft Certified Azure Solutions Architect Expert

positions.title: Software Engineer IV
positions.description: Product Team Developer and DevOps Professional.

positions.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
positions.description:
●        Serve as Azure and Microsoft 365 subject-matter expert across the FPI tenant and four external Farm Credit customer tenants, operating under GLBA and FCA financial-services governance.
●        Lead multi-tenant Azure delivery using a Terraform-first Infrastructure as Code model, standardizing modules, providers, governance, and tagging across all tenants.
●        Conducted a multi-tenant Azure cost-optimization and reservation audit across five tenants — covering reservations, Azure Advisor recommendations, and Azure Hybrid Benefit gaps — to support Finance and executive investment decisions.

positions.title: Data Platform Engineer
positions.description:
●        Built and deployed Terraform for a large Azure banking client (Northern Trust), developing reusable modules for core Azure resources.
●        Deployed Azure resources through GitHub Actions pipelines.
●        Delivered within multiple Agile / Scrum teams across internal and client-facing workstreams.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · Microsoft Azure · Automation · Consulting · Big Data

positions.title: Senior Cloud Systems Developer - Azure
positions.description:
●        Developed Terraform and PowerShell automation for two large Azure clients (Avaya and Cook County Health).
●        Built reusable Terraform modules and deployed via GitHub Actions and Terraform Cloud workspaces.
●        Implemented Azure Policy for NIST, SOX, and FedRAMP compliance as code.

positions.title: Senior Cloud Systems Engineer
positions.description:
●        Subject-matter expert for bank-wide Azure resources across two Azure tenants, using both Terraform and ARM templates.
●        One of three Azure Global Administrators for the bank; implemented a Privileged Identity Management (PIM) solution.
●        Delivered and operated App Registrations, Azure AD, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Data Lake Storage Gen2, Data Factory, Data Science VMs, Enterprise Applications, IAM, NSGs, Azure Policy, RBAC, Reservations, Security Center, SQL Managed Instance, Storage, and Subscriptions.

positions.title: Datacenter Migration Engineer
positions.description:
●        Migrated physical and virtual Windows and Linux servers to a new greenfield datacenter and to Microsoft Azure.
●        SME for Microsoft System Center (Configuration Manager, Operations Manager, and Virtual Machine Manager) across Hyper-V and VMware.
●        Managed automated patching for ~1,700 Windows servers.

positions.title: Enterprise Consultant
positions.description:
●        Migrated on-premises Exchange to Office 365 / Exchange Online for large organizations.
●        Built and supported customer VMware, Citrix, Hyper-V, Azure, and AWS environments.
●        Migrated Windows Server 2008 Active Directory and servers to Windows Server 2016.

positions.title: Infrastructure Delivery Assoc Manager - VMware Team Lead
positions.description:
●        Deployed a new VMware Validated Design 4.0 environment (64 ESXi 6.5 hosts; vCenter 6.5, Platform Services Controller, NSX, vRealize Automation / Operations / Orchestrator / Log Insight / Business, vSphere Replication, and Data Protection).
●        Principal engineer for the vSphere 5.5 → 6.5 migration supporting Internal Revenue Service VMware environments.
●        Mentored engineering staff and used PowerCLI to speed task resolution.

positions.title: Citrix/VMware Lead Systems Engineer
positions.description:
●        Tier 3 managed-services engineer for customer and internal environments.
●        Supported Azure, Citrix (XenApp / XenDesktop / XenServer), Windows and Red Hat Linux, Active Directory, Exchange, Hyper-V, SharePoint, SAN / NAS storage, SQL Server, Veritas, and VMware vSphere.
●        Escalation point for the 24/7 NOC; practice-group expert for AWS, Azure, Citrix, Hyper-V, and VMware; led numerous physical-to-virtual (P2V) migrations.
